thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 11/05/2018: SOGO, CYOU, STM, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 11/05/2018: SOGO, CYOU, STM, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -0.75%
AAPL: -1.58%
IBM: +0.32%
CSCO: +0.33%
GOOG: -0.26%
Technology stocks were mixed in early Monday trading.
Early movers include:
(-) Sogou ( SOGO ), which was declining more than 6% after the company reported financial results for Q3, with better-than-expected earnings and revenue that fell short of analysts' estimates; it also provided revenue guidance for fiscal 2018 below Street estimates.
(+) Changyou.com ( CYOU ) was higher by more than 5% as it swung to a profit in Q3 and provided the outlook for Q4.
(-) STMicroelectronics ( STM ) was down by over 2% after it announced a share repurchase program of up to $750 million to be carried out over the next three years.
